name: Password Sign-In Requires TOTP
summary: The user submits valid password credentials for a TOTP-enabled durable identity; the server returns the generic MFA-required outcome with provider=totp and the client routes to the canonical TOTP continuation surface.

preconditions.expression: session-capability == anonymous and an active, fully configured password-enabled durable identity with TOTP enabled is ready for sign-in

inputs.name: Email
inputs.description: Prepared test-user email resolved by the server before the runner plan is returned.

inputs.name: Password
inputs.description: Valid password generated by the test setup manager and resolved by the server before the runner plan is returned.

serverInteraction.intent: Submit the password through the normal password-sign-in flow and receive the generic MFA-required server outcome; provider=totp selects the client destination.

postconditions.expression: the password proof has succeeded, no authenticated application session is active, and the client has routed the provider=totp result to auth.continue.totp

sourceReferences.note: RequiresTwoFactor returns AuthenticationResponseState.MfaRequired; provider=totp is response metadata used by the client.
The server transition is generic MFA Required and does not own the TOTP destination.
Expected client destination is the existing canonical TOTP continuation view.
Response-directed routing is a client presentation obligation; provider-specific routing does not require a distinct C# flow proof.
